FIG-AARON.description_en: Aaron the high priest on the Day of Atonement: a man of about eighty with a short grey beard and grey hair; only plain white linen garments – a white linen tunic to the ankles, a white linen sash and a white linen turban; no gold, no breastplate, no coloured cloth.

FIG-ABRAHAM.description_en: Abraham (Abram): an old man with long white hair and a long white beard, a pale cream head cloth, a cream tunic and an ochre-brown mantle with two broad darker brown stripes, a plain wanderer's staff. Never with stone tablets.

FIG-AHASVEROS.description_en: King Ahasuerus (Xerxes) of Persia: a man of about thirty-five with a full curled black beard, a tall fluted gold crown, a deep purple robe with a white sash; dignified, never caricatured.

FIG-AHIJA.description_en: Ahijah of Shiloh: an old prophet with a long grey beard and grey hair; a dark brown rough wool mantle; he wears over it a new, clean pale-cream outer garment, which he tears.

FIG-AMAZJA.description_en: Amaziah, priest of Bethel: a man of about fifty-five, neatly trimmed grey beard, a white linen robe with a dark blue sash and a plain white linen headband; dignified official bearing, not caricatured, no marks of any later religion.

FIG-AMOS.description_en: Amos: a herdsman of about forty-five from the Judean hills, sun-weathered face, short greying dark beard, short hair; a coarse undyed brown wool tunic with a sheepskin over one shoulder, a plain wooden shepherd's staff; upright and plain, bare-headed.

FIG-APOLLOS.description_en: Apollos: a man of about thirty, lightly bearded, petrol-blue mantle over a light robe, a scroll under his arm.

FIG-ARTAXERXES.description_en: King Artaxerxes of Persia: a man of about fifty with a long curled grey beard, a tall fluted gold crown, a long white robe with a broad purple mantle; dignified, never caricatured.

FIG-BALAK.description_en: Balak, king of Moab: a man of about fifty with a black beard, a simple gold circlet on his head, a saffron-yellow mantle over a dark robe.

FIG-BARAK.description_en: Barak: a man of about thirty-five, short black beard, black hair; a brown leather jerkin over a grey-green tunic, a spear in his hand.

FIG-BARUCH.description_en: Baruch the scribe: a man of about thirty-five, neatly trimmed dark beard, short dark hair; a clean pale blue-grey robe, a wooden scribe's palette with reed pens tucked in his belt.

FIG-BILEAM.description_en: Balaam: a seer from the Euphrates, a man of about sixty with a long grey beard and grey hair, a deep plum-purple robe and a dark shawl over his shoulders.

FIG-BOAS.description_en: Boaz: a man of about fifty, grey-streaked dark beard, kind face; a petrol-blue mantle over a light robe with a narrow gold hem; a wooden winnowing fork belongs to him.

FIG-DANIEL.description_en: Daniel in old age: a man of about eighty, white hair and a full white beard, calm steady face; a long pale blue-grey court robe with an ochre-gold sash.

FIG-DANIEL-JUNG.description_en: Young Daniel: a youth of about eighteen, short dark curly hair, the first hint of a beard, open earnest face; a pale blue-grey court tunic with an ochre-gold sash.

FIG-DARIUS-MEDER.description_en: King Darius the Mede: a man of about sixty, grey beard, a tall rounded felt royal cap in pale ochre, a long deep-violet robe with a gold border; anxious, sleepless face.

FIG-DAVID.description_en: David: a man with reddish-brown hair and a short reddish-brown beard (beardless as a youth), bright eyes, lean and agile; a deep wine-red tunic (clearly darker and more purple than terracotta) with a golden-ochre mantle; as king a thin plain gold circlet on his head, never before he is king. His age is given in each scene.

FIG-DEBORA.description_en: Deborah: a woman of about fifty, dark hair with grey streaks under a long deep-indigo headscarf, a calm, authoritative face; a saffron-yellow robe with a plain sand-coloured mantle.

FIG-DIOTREPHES.description_en: Diotrephes: a man of about forty-five, black hair, short beard, upright and stern, bare-headed; a grey-brown robe; serious and closed, not demonised, not caricatured.

FIG-ELI.description_en: Eli: a very old, heavy priest with a white beard and dim, half-closed eyes, in a white linen tunic and a blue-grey mantle.

FIG-ELIJA.description_en: Elijah: a lean, weathered man of about fifty, long unkempt dark-grey hair and a full dark-grey beard; a rough brown hairy mantle of goat hair over a plain undyed short tunic, a leather belt.

FIG-ELISA.description_en: Elisha: a man with a bald head and a short dark beard, a plain sand-coloured tunic; after Elijah is taken he carries Elijah's rough brown hairy mantle. His age is given in each scene.

FIG-ESRA.description_en: Ezra, priest and scribe: a man of about fifty-five, a long grey-streaked dark beard, a white linen turban, a long white robe under an indigo-blue mantle; often with a scroll.

FIG-ESTER.description_en: Esther, queen of Persia: a young Jewish woman of about twenty with long dark hair, a calm and determined face; a small gold crown, a white veil edged with gold, a deep teal-blue royal robe.

FIG-EWIL-MERODACH.description_en: Evil-merodach, king of Babylon: a man of about forty with a long, squared, curled black beard, a tall rounded white royal cap with a gold band, a long deep-blue robe.

FIG-EZECHIEL.description_en: Ezekiel: a man of about thirty from a priestly family, dark hair, a full dark beard, intense face; an ochre-yellow robe and a plain white linen head cloth.

FIG-GAIUS.description_en: Gaius: a man of about fifty, short greying beard, kind open face, bare-headed; a deep warm brown robe with a cream sash, no staff.

FIG-GELIEBTE.description_en: The young woman of the Song: about twenty, long dark hair partly covered by a pale rose head-scarf, sun-browned face; a long, modest deep indigo-blue dress with long sleeves.

FIG-GELIEBTER.description_en: The young man of the Song: about twenty-two, dark curly hair, short dark beard, sun-browned face; a saffron-yellow tunic with a brown belt and a light brown shepherd's cloak over one shoulder.

FIG-GIDEON.description_en: Gideon: a wiry man of about thirty-five, dark curly hair, short dark beard; a plain sand-coloured farmer's tunic and a deep-green cloak, a curved ram's horn hanging at his belt.

FIG-GOMER.description_en: Gomer: a young woman of about twenty, long dark hair under a saffron-yellow veil, a dusty-rose ankle-length robe with long sleeves, modestly and fully dressed; dignified, never sensual or caricatured.

FIG-GRUPPE-ACKERBAUERN.description_en: Farmers and vine-dressers of ancient Judah: two sturdy men, one about fifty with a greying beard in a plain brown belted work tunic, one about thirty with a short dark beard in an undyed tunic with a rope belt; dusty bare feet, sun-browned arms; dignified, not caricatured.

FIG-GRUPPE-AELTESTE.description_en: Old men who had seen the first temple: white beards, slightly bent, bare-headed, grey overmantles, one with a staff.

FIG-GRUPPE-ARBEITER.description_en: Builders and burden-bearers: men of different ages in short ochre belted work tunics with headbands, bare arms.

FIG-GRUPPE-BAALSPROPHETEN.description_en: The prophets of Baal: many men of different ages in long dull mustard-yellow robes, bare-headed, long dark hair; dignified, never caricatured, no marks of any present-day religion or group.

FIG-GRUPPE-BABYLONIER.description_en: Babylonian soldiers: men with full curled black beards, pointed bronze helmets, plain knee-length tunics with a broad belt, short spears and round shields; never caricatured.

FIG-GRUPPE-BRUEDER-JOSEFS.description_en: Joseph's brothers: bearded Canaanite shepherds of different ages in long wool robes of brown, ochre and grey, some with plain head cloths; the youngest, Benjamin, with a short dark beard and a sand-coloured robe; dignified, never caricatured.

FIG-GRUPPE-DIENER.description_en: The servants: men and women of different ages in plain sand-coloured belted tunics with pale linen aprons, sleeves rolled up, bare-headed.

FIG-GRUPPE-ENGEL.description_en: The messengers of God: four or five slender men in plain long white robes, bare-headed, without wings and without halos; calm, walking upright.

FIG-GRUPPE-FRAUEN.description_en: The women of Bethlehem: women of different ages with light headscarves and earth-coloured robes, dignified.

FIG-GRUPPE-FREUNDE-DANIELS.description_en: Daniel's three friends (Hananiah, Mishael, Azariah): three young Judean men of about eighteen to twenty-five, dark hair, short or beginning beards; court clothing of the Babylonian palace: knee-length tunics over loose trousers, small felt caps, in muted moss-green, sand and dusty rose; dignified.

FIG-GRUPPE-FREUNDE-HIOB.description_en: Job's three friends, dignified older men from neighbouring lands, all bare-headed: Eliphaz, the oldest, with a white beard and a dark green mantle; Bildad with a brown beard and an ochre-brown mantle; Zophar, the youngest, with a black beard and a slate-blue mantle. Never caricatured.

FIG-GRUPPE-GESCHWISTER.description_en: The brothers and sisters: a man and a woman in muted blue-grey robes with light overmantles, bare-headed or with a plain pale head covering; dignified, not caricatured.

FIG-GRUPPE-GLAUBENDE.description_en: The believers: ordinary men and women of different ages in dove-blue robes with pale cream overmantles, bare-headed or with plain pale head coverings; dignified, not caricatured.

FIG-GRUPPE-HOFBEAMTE.description_en: Babylonian court officials: two men of about forty to sixty with trimmed beards, long robes of ochre and grey with fringed borders, small round caps; astonished, dignified.

FIG-GRUPPE-IRRLEHRER.description_en: The deceivers: well-dressed men in plain grey-brown robes, one with a scroll; earnest, persuasive faces; never caricatured, no marks of any ethnic group or religion (no tassels, prayer straps, prayer shawls or skullcaps).

FIG-GRUPPE-KRIEGER.description_en: Israelite fighting men: men of different ages in plain undyed and brown belted tunics, some with a short sword at the belt or a spear; no armour, no helmets.

FIG-GRUPPE-KUNDSCHAFTER.description_en: The other spies: bearded men of different ages in plain grey and dun-coloured travelling robes, dusty, with staffs and head cloths; dignified, never caricatured.

FIG-GRUPPE-LEUTE-JAKOBUS.description_en: The men who came from James: two bearded men of about forty in plain sand-and-olive robes, bare-headed, serious and reserved, arms folded; dignified, never caricatured, no marks of any ethnic group or religion (no tassels, prayer straps, prayer shawls or skullcaps).

FIG-GRUPPE-MANN-UND-FRAU.description_en: A young man and a young woman standing side by side, seen at full length: he with short dark hair and a short beard, she with long dark hair; both in plain undyed knee-length linen tunics; calm, natural, modest.

FIG-GRUPPE-MENGE.description_en: Jewish people of Jerusalem: men, women and children of different ages in everyday robes in sand, grey, blue-grey and white, some with simple plain head coverings; dignified and varied, never caricatured or stereotyped.

FIG-GRUPPE-PHILISTER.description_en: The Philistines: men and women in festive white and pale saffron garments with broad dark-blue borders, some men clean-shaven, some with short beards; feasting and laughing; dignified, never caricatured, no marks of any present-day group.

FIG-GRUPPE-PRIESTER.description_en: Priests and Levites of ancient Israel: bearded men of different ages in plain white linen robes with white head wraps and a blue sash; dignified, never caricatured.

FIG-GRUPPE-REISENDE.description_en: The travelling believers: two or three men and women of different ages in light, dusty brown travelling cloaks with headbands, each with a walking staff, one with a bundle on the back; dignified, not caricatured.

FIG-GRUPPE-SCHAFHAENDLER.description_en: Sheep dealers: two well-fed men of about fifty in good striped brown and ochre robes with belts and short mantles, one holding a small money pouch; watchful, arms folded; not caricatured.

FIG-GRUPPE-SEELEUTE.description_en: Sailors: three sturdy men of different ages in short undyed work tunics with headbands, bare arms.

FIG-GRUPPE-SOEHNE-ISAI.description_en: Jesse's elder sons: grown men of different ages with dark beards in plain brown, grey and sand-coloured robes; the eldest tall and impressive.

FIG-GRUPPE-SOLDATEN.description_en: Roman soldiers: clean-shaven young men with plain iron helmets without crest, olive-grey tunics and short dull brown cloaks (no red anywhere); no weapons raised.

FIG-GRUPPE-STADTWACHE.description_en: City guards: two men in plain dark-brown short tunics with round leather caps and short spears; not Roman legionaries, no helmets with crests; dignified, not caricatured.

FIG-GRUPPE-VERBANNTE.description_en: Exiles from Judah in Babylonia: three or four men and women of different ages in plain, worn robes of grey, brown and faded blue, the women with simple pale veils; tired but attentive, dignified, never caricatured.

FIG-GRUPPE-VOELKER.description_en: People of the nations: a man and a woman of different ages and peoples in strong blue robes with dark brown overmantles and simple head bands; dignified, no typed marks of any ethnic group.

FIG-GRUPPE-VOLK.description_en: The people of Jerusalem and Judah: men, women and older children of different ages in plain robes in sand, grey, olive and blue-grey, some with plain pale head coverings; dignified and varied, never caricatured.

FIG-GRUPPE-ZEUGEN.description_en: Witnesses: two older men of Judah with grey beards in plain brown and grey robes, bare-headed, one holding a reed pen.

FIG-HABAKUK.description_en: Habakkuk: a man of about fifty, greying dark beard, deep-set searching eyes, short greying hair; a mustard-ochre robe with a dark brown wool mantle, bare-headed.

FIG-HAGGAI.description_en: Haggai: an old man of about seventy, white hair and full white beard, keen lively eyes; a sand-coloured tunic with a deep olive-brown mantle, a plain walking staff, bare-headed.

FIG-HAMAN.description_en: Haman, the king's highest official: a tall man of about forty-five with a neatly trimmed black beard and black hair, bare-headed; a saffron-yellow courtier's robe with a dark brown mantle and a gold seal ring; proud bearing, never caricatured, no marks of any ethnic group or religion.

FIG-HANAMEL.description_en: Hanamel, Jeremiah's cousin: a man of about forty, round face, full black beard, a striped head cloth, a mustard-yellow robe, a small leather purse at his belt.

FIG-HEILIGER-GEIST.description_en: The Spirit descending like a dove: one plain white dove gliding downwards with open wings. Only a bird – no halo, no rays, no glow, no light around it.

FIG-HIOB.description_en: Job: a lean man of about sixty with a long grey beard and grey hair, bare-headed; a plain undyed off-white robe (torn and ash-stained in his suffering, clean at the end).

FIG-HISKIJA.description_en: King Hezekiah of Judah: a man of about forty, short dark beard, dark hair; a simple thin gold circlet on his head, an ochre-gold royal mantle over a cream robe.

FIG-HOSEA.description_en: Hosea: a man of about thirty-five, dark curly hair, full dark beard, earnest gentle face; a deep indigo-blue robe with a plain undyed wool mantle over one shoulder, bare-headed.

FIG-ISAAK.description_en: Isaac as a youth: a boy of about fifteen, beardless, short dark curly hair; a plain light-blue knee-length tunic, barefoot or in sandals.

FIG-ISAI.description_en: Jesse: an older man with a grey beard and a shepherd's staff, an ochre robe with a brown mantle.

FIG-JAKOB.description_en: Jacob: a man of middle age, dark hair and a full dark beard; an indigo-blue tunic and a brown woollen travelling cloak.

FIG-JEHUDI.description_en: Jehudi, a royal servant: a young man of about twenty-five, clean-shaven or very short beard, a pale sand-coloured robe with a narrow blue border, holding an unrolled scroll.

FIG-JEREMIA.description_en: Jeremiah: a lean man of about fifty, dark hair and a short dark beard with grey streaks, a serious, sorrowful face; an undyed grey-brown robe with a plain white linen belt, bare-headed.

FIG-JEROBEAM.description_en: Jeroboam: a vigorous man of about thirty, short black beard, black hair; a mustard-ochre tunic with a brown belt and a leather satchel of an overseer.

FIG-JESAJA.description_en: Isaiah: a man of about thirty-five, dark hair, a full dark beard, earnest face; a deep indigo-blue mantle over a sand-coloured tunic, bare-headed.

FIG-JESCHUA.description_en: Joshua (Jeshua) the high priest: a man of about fifty, grey beard; a plain white linen robe with a blue sash and a white linen turban; no breastplate jewels, dignified, not caricatured.

FIG-JESUS.description_en: Jesus: a Galilean man in his early thirties, shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair, short full dark beard, warm brown eyes, olive skin, a kind and open face that is always fully visible like everyone else's; cream linen tunic and a muted terracotta-red mantle over one shoulder. No halo. He is the only person wearing terracotta-red.

FIG-JESUS-KIND.description_en: The newborn Jesus: a tiny baby wrapped tightly in pale cream swaddling cloths, only the small face visible. No halo, no glow.

FIG-JOHANNES-PATMOS.description_en: John on Patmos: an old man of about seventy with a full white beard and white hair, bare-headed, weathered face; a dark olive-green robe with an undyed wool mantle; scroll and reed pen.

FIG-JOHANNES-TAEUFER.description_en: John the Baptist: a lean, sun-browned man of about thirty, long unkempt dark hair, full dark beard; a rough brown camel-hair garment tied with a plain leather belt, bare arms and shins.

FIG-JOJACHIN.description_en: Jehoiachin: a thin man of about fifty-five, grey-streaked black hair and beard, many years of prison in his face; here in a new, clean plain white robe.

FIG-JOJAKIM.description_en: King Jehoiakim of Judah: a man of about thirty-five, well-groomed black beard, a heavy gold circlet, a rich deep-purple royal mantle over a white robe, seated on a carved chair, a small scribe's knife in his hand; cold, unmoved face.

FIG-JONA.description_en: Jonah: a man of about forty, short dark beard, dark hair, weather-worn face; a sea-blue robe (the only person in sea-blue), bare-headed.

FIG-JOSCHIJA.description_en: Josiah: a young king of about twenty-six, short black beard, black hair, a plain gold circlet; a deep indigo-blue robe with a silver-grey mantle.

FIG-JOSEF.description_en: Joseph as vizier of Egypt: a man of about forty, clean-shaven, short dark hair; a fine white linen garment to the ankles and a broad gold collar on his chest, a gold ring on his hand.

FIG-JOSEF-NAZARET.description_en: Joseph of Nazareth: a man of about thirty, short dark hair, full dark beard, strong hands of a craftsman; an ochre robe with a dark umber-brown mantle (clearly browner and darker than terracotta).

FIG-JOSUA.description_en: Joshua: a man of about forty with a short dark beard and short dark hair, an olive-green tunic and a short brown cloak.

FIG-KAEMMERER.description_en: The Ethiopian court official: a dignified man of about forty from the kingdom of Kush (Ethiopia), dark brown skin, short black hair, clean-shaven, a calm and intelligent face; a fine long white linen robe with an indigo sash and a pale headcloth. Never caricatured.

FIG-KALEB.description_en: Caleb: a sturdy man of about forty with a full dark beard and dark hair, a mustard-yellow robe with a plain belt; confident bearing.

FIG-KORNELIUS.description_en: Cornelius: a Roman centurion of about fifty, short grey hair, clean-shaven, an open and devout face; at home without helmet or weapon: an off-white tunic and a dark slate-blue cloak.

FIG-LAZARUS-BINDEN.description_en: Lazarus coming out of the tomb: a man of about thirty-five, alive and upright, his body, hands and feet loosely wound with pale linen strips, a linen cloth tied around his head that hangs over his chin and mouth; eyes open, dazed. Never like a mummy or a corpse.

FIG-MARIA-BETANIEN.description_en: Mary of Bethany: a woman of about thirty, dark hair loosely under a grey-green veil, a gentle face; a grey-green robe.

FIG-MARIA-MAGDALA.description_en: Mary Magdalene: a woman of about thirty, dark hair under a pale veil; a light robe with a deep plum-wine mantle (clearly darker and more purple than terracotta); a small alabaster jar with a lid.

FIG-MARIA-MUTTER-JAKOBUS.description_en: Mary the mother of James: a woman of about fifty, greying hair under a pale veil; an olive-green robe; a small open clay jar of spices.

FIG-MARIA-MUTTER-JESU.description_en: Mary, the mother of Jesus: clearly one generation older than her adult son, grey streaks in her dark hair visible under the veil, gentle lines around eyes and mouth, slightly stooped posture; blue-grey veil and blue-grey robe.

FIG-MARTA.description_en: Martha: a woman of about forty, dark hair under a sand-coloured veil, a capable, direct face; a warm ochre robe.

FIG-MICHAL.description_en: Michal: a woman of about thirty-five, black hair under a deep-teal veil, small gold earrings, a fine pale-gold robe; seen at a window.

FIG-MITHREDAT.description_en: Mithredath, the Persian treasurer: a man of about sixty with a short trimmed grey beard, a rounded felt cap, a long ochre robe with a dark belt; a wax writing tablet in his hand.

FIG-MORDECHAI.description_en: Mordecai: an older man of about sixty with a full white-grey beard and short grey hair, bare-headed; a sand-coloured robe with a dark blue mantle (in the honour scene a long purple royal robe over it).

FIG-MOSE.description_en: Moses: an old man with long white hair and a full white beard, a weathered, earnest face; a cream tunic under a plain earth-brown mantle without stripes, a leather belt; a long plain wooden shepherd's staff. No horns, no rays or glow around his head; no stone tablets unless the scene names them.

FIG-NAAMAN.description_en: Naaman: an Aramean army commander of about forty-five, strong build, short dark beard and close-cut dark hair; his deep-green commander's mantle and bronze scale armour laid aside, he wears only a short white linen undertunic.

FIG-NATAN.description_en: Nathan the prophet: a man of about fifty-five, short grey hair and grey beard, a plain dark-brown rough mantle over an undyed tunic, a wooden staff.

FIG-NEBUKADNEZZAR.description_en: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon: a powerful man of about fifty, long dark beard in neat rows, a tall rounded Babylonian royal cap with a ribbon, a long deep-blue robe with a gold-fringed border; never caricatured.

FIG-NEHEMIA.description_en: Nehemiah, cupbearer of the Persian king and later governor of Judah: a man of about forty, short dark beard, short dark hair, bare-headed; an olive-green robe with a pale ochre sash.

FIG-NOOMI.description_en: Naomi: an older woman of about sixty, grey hair under a dark charcoal widow's headscarf, a lined, expressive face; a plain stone-grey robe.

FIG-OBED.description_en: Obed: a newborn baby wrapped in a light cream cloth.

FIG-OBJ-ALTAR.description_en: Seven low altars of rough field stones in a row, each with thin grey smoke rising; no visible flames.

FIG-OBJ-BAUM-DES-LEBENS.description_en: The tree of life: a broad leafy tree with a round green crown and round fruit among its leaves, one on each bank of the river.

FIG-OBJ-BECHER-VOLL.description_en: A simple earthenware cup with red wine.

FIG-OBJ-BRUNNEN.description_en: A well: a round well-head of rough grey stones with a dark opening; above it a simple wooden frame with a wooden pulley wheel.

FIG-OBJ-DORNBUSCH.description_en: A low thorny desert bush with small green leaves, burning with a few loose orange-red flames while its branches and leaves stay green and whole; no face or figure in the fire, no glow around it.

FIG-OBJ-EHERNE-SCHLANGE.description_en: A serpent made of bronze, warm bronze-brown, hanging over the top of a tall plain wooden pole that stands in a heap of stones.

FIG-OBJ-EISENPLATTE.description_en: A flat iron baking plate set upright on its edge like a small wall, dark grey.

FIG-OBJ-ESEL.description_en: A grey donkey with a plain saddle cloth and a few bundles.

FIG-OBJ-FEIGENBAUM.description_en: A fig tree with large lobed fresh green leaves and small green unripe figs.

FIG-OBJ-FEIGENBAUM-VERDORRT.description_en: A fig tree stripped bare by locusts: no leaves and no fruit, its bark gnawed off so that the branches show pale white.

FIG-OBJ-FISCH.description_en: A single blue fish swimming to the left, simple and friendly, painted in soft watercolour.

FIG-OBJ-GARBE.description_en: A single sheaf of golden barley stalks tied in the middle with a cord, standing upright.

FIG-OBJ-GEBEINE.description_en: A few small, smooth, pale bones lying scattered on the sand, drawn as simple light strokes; no skulls, no whole skeletons.

FIG-OBJ-GEMUESE.description_en: A simple clay bowl of vegetables and pulses (beans, lentils, leeks) and a plain clay jug of water.

FIG-OBJ-GOLDSCHALE.description_en: A small golden bowl, as for a hanging oil lamp, cracked, with a thin silver cord torn beside it.

FIG-OBJ-GROSSER-FISCH.description_en: A huge grey-blue fish, simple shape, no teeth shown, not a cartoon.

FIG-OBJ-HEUSCHRECKEN.description_en: Locusts: large brownish-green desert locusts with long hind legs, a few sitting on the ground and on bare branches, a thin swarm far away as tiny dark specks; natural, not monstrous.

FIG-OBJ-HIMMELSLEITER.description_en: A broad stairway of plain pale stone steps rising diagonally from the ground and fading out into the white paper, without railing, without anything at its top.

FIG-OBJ-HIRTENSTAB.description_en: A shepherd's staff and rod: a long plain wooden staff with a curved crook at the top, and beside it a short, thick wooden club; no ornaments.

FIG-OBJ-HIRTENSTAEBE.description_en: Two plain wooden shepherd's staffs of the same length, slightly crooked at the top.

FIG-OBJ-KAUFBRIEF.description_en: Two deeds of purchase: two small rolled documents of papyrus, one tied with string and sealed with a small lump of clay, the other left open.

FIG-OBJ-KETTE.description_en: A light iron chain linking the prisoner's wrist to the guard's wrist.

FIG-OBJ-KOHLENFEUER.description_en: A bronze brazier on three short legs with glowing charcoal and low small flames.

FIG-OBJ-KORB.description_en: A large, sturdy woven basket, big enough for a crouching man, hanging from a rope.

FIG-OBJ-KREUZ.description_en: A plain wooden cross of rough beams.

FIG-OBJ-LADE.description_en: The ark of the covenant: a wooden chest about as long as a man is tall, carried on two long poles on the shoulders of four priests; while it is carried it is wrapped in a plain blue cloth, so that nothing on its lid is seen.

FIG-OBJ-LAMM.description_en: A small white lamb standing, side view, soft wool, gentle face.

FIG-OBJ-LAMPE.description_en: A small clay oil lamp with a tiny flame; no glow, no rays.

FIG-OBJ-LANZE.description_en: Saul's spear: a long wooden shaft with a plain iron point.

FIG-OBJ-LEUCHTER-SACHARJA.description_en: A tall lampstand of gold: one straight shaft standing on a round foot, on top a wide round bowl, and seven small clay oil lamps set around the rim of the bowl, each with a small steady flame; not a seven-branched candelabrum, no glow and no rays.

FIG-OBJ-LOEWEN.description_en: Three lions: large, tawny, simply drawn, lying or standing quietly with closed mouths, not attacking.

FIG-OBJ-MANDELBAUM.description_en: An almond tree in full white blossom on dark bare branches, no leaves yet.

FIG-OBJ-MANTEL.description_en: Elijah's mantle: a rough brown hairy mantle of goat hair.

FIG-OBJ-PEITSCHE.description_en: A short whip made of a few knotted cords.

FIG-OBJ-POSAUNE.description_en: Trumpets: long, straight, slender gold-yellow metal trumpets with a flared bell (not a ram's horn).

FIG-OBJ-RIND.description_en: Young bulls: brown cattle with short horns, tethered with ropes.

FIG-OBJ-RIZINUS-VERDORRT.description_en: A withered castor-oil plant with large hand-shaped leaves hanging down dry and brown.

FIG-OBJ-SANDALE.description_en: A pair of plain leather sandals lying on the sand.

FIG-OBJ-SCHAF.description_en: A small flock of thin sheep with greyish-white wool.

FIG-OBJ-SCHIFF.description_en: A small wooden merchant ship of the 8th century BC with one mast.

FIG-OBJ-SCHLANGE.description_en: A few small, dark brown desert snakes on the sand, simple shapes, slithering away.

FIG-OBJ-SCHREIBTAFEL.description_en: Two smooth flat writing boards coated with pale plaster, each about the size of a small door panel; one leaning against the parapet, one on the writer's knees, with a few bold dark strokes and no legible writing.

FIG-OBJ-SCHRIFTROLLE.description_en: A scroll on two plain wooden rods.

FIG-OBJ-STEIN.description_en: A single large upright standing stone, rough and grey, about as tall as a man.

FIG-OBJ-STEINE.description_en: Rounded grey river stones, each as big as a man can carry on his shoulder.

FIG-OBJ-STERN.description_en: A night sky full of countless tiny stars: a band of pale night-blue wash with many small specks of white paper left free; no large star, no glow, no rays.

FIG-OBJ-TAUBE.description_en: A turtle-dove: a small grey-brown dove with a dark striped patch on the side of the neck.

FIG-OBJ-TEMPELGERAETE.description_en: Temple vessels: plain, shallow gold and silver bowls and basins of different sizes, without decoration and without any shine effect.

FIG-OBJ-TOEPFERSCHEIBE.description_en: An ancient potter's wheel: two round flat stone discs on a short axle at ground level, the potter sits on a low stool and turns the lower disc with his foot; a lump of wet grey-brown clay on the upper disc.

FIG-OBJ-TONKRUG.description_en: A plain earthenware storage jar, knee-high, reddish-brown, with a lid.

FIG-OBJ-WAAGE.description_en: A small hand balance: a bar with two shallow bronze pans on cords, and a few small irregular pieces of silver.

FIG-OBJ-WAGEN.description_en: A travelling carriage: a light two-wheeled wooden carriage with a seat, drawn by one horse.

FIG-OBJ-WEINSTOCK.description_en: A vine on a low wooden trellis with fresh green leaves and small pale blossoms, no grapes yet.

FIG-OBJ-WEINTRAUBE.description_en: One huge cluster of dark purple grapes hanging from a wooden carrying pole, so heavy that the pole bends; a small basket of pomegranates and figs.

FIG-OBJ-WIDDER.description_en: A ram: a sturdy grey-white male sheep with large curled horns.

FIG-OBJ-WIDDERHORN.description_en: A ram's horn (shofar): a long, curved, ridged natural horn, pale ochre to brown, blown from the narrow end.

FIG-OBJ-ZEPTER.description_en: A long slender golden sceptre with a small round knob at its tip.

FIG-OBJ-ZIEGEL.description_en: A large flat sun-dried mud brick lying on the ground, with a simple outline of a walled city scratched into it; around it tiny model siege works: a small earth ramp, a few little tents and two small wooden battering rams.

FIG-OBJ-ZIMBELN.description_en: Cymbals: a pair of small round bronze cymbals held one in each hand.

FIG-ONESIMUS.description_en: Onesimus: a young man in his twenties, short dark hair, beardless, slim and upright; a plain undyed short tunic with a warm ochre travelling cloak over his shoulders and a walking staff; no chains, no collar, dignified.

FIG-ORNAN.description_en: Ornan (Araunah) the Jebusite: a farmer of about fifty, a broad short grey-brown beard, a plain undyed head cloth tied at the back, a short belted olive-brown work tunic with rolled-up sleeves.

FIG-ORPA.description_en: Orpah: a young woman of about twenty-five in a dusty-rose robe and a pale sand headscarf, a travel bundle on her back.

FIG-ORT-AEGYPTEN.description_en: A hall in an Egyptian house: two plain columns with lotus capitals and a pale sand-coloured wall, drawn with a few lines.

FIG-ORT-BERG.description_en: A mountain in Galilee: a broad, bare hilltop with a few rocks, drawn with a few lines and one pale olive wash.

FIG-ORT-DAMASKUS.description_en: Damascus: a long plain city wall of pale stone blocks with one small window high up and a closed wooden gate, drawn with a few lines.

FIG-ORT-FEUEROFEN.description_en: A large brick furnace of ancient Babylon: a dome of mud bricks with one wide arched opening at ground level; inside, fire as a few warm orange washes, no glow spreading outside.

FIG-ORT-GEFAENGNIS.description_en: A bare room of Roman custody: one plain wall line, a small high window, a low wooden bench; drawn with a few lines.

FIG-ORT-NEUES-JERUSALEM.description_en: The holy city: a broad street of pale ochre paving without gloss, a low city wall with an open gate hinted at with a few lines far behind; no glow, no rays.

FIG-ORT-NINIVE.description_en: Nineveh: long mud-brick walls with a gate and a small stepped tower, drawn with a few lines.

FIG-ORT-PRAETORIUM.description_en: A Roman official building, suggested only by two or three pale stone columns and a step, drawn with a few lines.

FIG-ORT-SEE.description_en: The Sea of Galilee: open water with low hills far away.
